calls.statement:
SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, period_start_date, period_end_date 
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar 
WHERE fiscal_period = 4
ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC

SELECT 
  store_id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_fy2627,
  SUM(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_fy2526
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT store_id, d.fiscal_year
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales s
  JOIN dim_date d ON s.business_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_period = 4
    AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27', 'FY2025/26')
) t
GROUP BY store_id
ORDER BY store_id

SELECT 
  s.store_id,
  ds.store_name,
  d.fiscal_year,
  SUM(s.net_sales) as period_net_sales
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales s
JOIN dim_store ds ON s.store_id = ds.store_id AND ds.is_current = TRUE
JOIN dim_date d ON s.business_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_period = 4
  AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27', 'FY2025/26')
  AND s.store_id < 900  -- exclude web channel
GROUP BY s.store_id, ds.store_name, d.fiscal_year
ORDER BY s.store_id, d.fiscal_year DESC

WITH period_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    s.store_id,
    SUM(s.net_sales) as net_sales
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales s
  JOIN dim_date d ON s.business_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_period = 4
    AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27', 'FY2025/26')
    AND s.store_id < 900
    AND s.store_id != 129  -- exclude store that closed
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, s.store_id
),
lfl_stores AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT store_id
  FROM period_sales
  GROUP BY store_id
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT fiscal_year) = 2
),
lfl_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    SUM(s.net_sales) as total_net_sales
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales s
  JOIN dim_date d ON s.business_date = d.calendar_date
  JOIN lfl_stores ls ON s.store_id = ls.store_id
  WHERE d.fiscal_period = 4
    AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27', 'FY2025/26')
    AND s.store_id < 900
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_year
)
SELECT 
  fiscal_year,
  total_net_sales,
  ROUND((total_net_sales / LAG(total_net_sales) OVER (ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC) - 1) * 100, 2) as pct_change
FROM lfl_sales
ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  COUNT(DISTINCT d.calendar_date) as calendar_days,
  SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_trading_day THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as trading_days,
  SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_public_holiday THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as public_holidays
FROM dim_date d
WHERE d.fiscal_period = 4
  AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27', 'FY2025/26')
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year
ORDER BY d.fiscal_year DESC

WITH lfl_stores AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s.store_id
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales s
  JOIN dim_date d ON s.business_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_period = 4
    AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27', 'FY2025/26')
    AND s.store_id < 900
  GROUP BY s.store_id
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT d.fiscal_year) = 2
),
store_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    s.store_id,
    ds.store_name,
    d.fiscal_year,
    SUM(s.net_sales) as net_sales
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales s
  JOIN dim_date d ON s.business_date = d.calendar_date
  JOIN dim_store ds ON s.store_id = ds.store_id AND ds.is_current = TRUE
  JOIN lfl_stores ls ON s.store_id = ls.store_id
  WHERE d.fiscal_period = 4
    AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27', 'FY2025/26')
  GROUP BY s.store_id, ds.store_name, d.fiscal_year
)
SELECT 
  store_id,
  store_name,
  MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' THEN net_sales END) as fy2627_sales,
  MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' THEN net_sales END) as fy2526_sales,
  ROUND(
    (MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' THEN net_sales END) / 
     MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' THEN net_sales END) - 1) * 100, 
    2
  ) as pct_change
FROM store_sales
GROUP BY store_id, store_name
ORDER BY pct_change DESC

-- Like-for-like (LFL) sales comparison: Period 4 FY2026/27 vs FY2025/26
-- Includes only stores operating in both periods (excluding store 129 which closed)
WITH lfl_stores AS (
  -- Identify stores with sales data in both fiscal years
  SELECT DISTINCT s.store_id
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales s
  JOIN dim_date d ON s.business_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_period = 4
    AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27', 'FY2025/26')
    AND s.store_id < 900  -- Exclude web channel
  GROUP BY s.store_id
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT d.fiscal_year) = 2
),
sales_by_year AS (
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    SUM(s.net_sales) as total_net_sales
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales s
  JOIN dim_date d ON s.business_date = d.calendar_date
  JOIN lfl_stores ls ON s.store_id = ls.store_id
  WHERE d.fiscal_period = 4
    AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27', 'FY2025/26')
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_year
)
SELECT 
  MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' THEN total_net_sales END) as fy2627_net_sales,
  MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' THEN total_net_sales END) as fy2526_net_sales,
  ROUND(
    (MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' THEN total_net_sales END) / 
     MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' THEN total_net_sales END) - 1) * 100, 
    2
  ) as lfl_pct_change
FROM sales_by_year
